entities.summary: Giorgos Patoulis is a Greek politician and surgeon. He served as Regional Governor of Attica from 2019 to 2023. He is also President of Athens Medical Association, since 2011. He is a member of the New Democracy. Giorgios Patoulis was a physicians & medical pioneers from Athens (b. 1961-05-14, Athens). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
